pageHelp.automation.body: Automation runs a list of steps against your profiles. That list is a project: every click and keystroke goes through the browser’s own human-input engine, so a page sees a person and not a script. Modules are files you write that add steps of their own: open a project, choose “Add step”, then “Manage modules”.
pageHelp.automation.title: About automation
pageHelp.bookmarks.body: A bookmark you add to a folder shows up in every profile in that folder. You save a site once instead of in each browser. Pick a folder to see what its profiles get.
pageHelp.bookmarks.title: About bookmarks
pageHelp.extensions.body: An extension adds a feature to a profile’s browser, such as an ad blocker. Add one here, then turn it on for each profile in its details panel (Peek). Paste a Web Store link, or add a .crx, .zip or unpacked folder.
pageHelp.extensions.title: About extensions
pageHelp.fingerprints.body: A fingerprint is the hardware identity a profile shows to sites, such as its GPU and screen. This library holds the ones new profiles are built on, and each is checked against this computer’s GPU. Import your own to add more.
pageHelp.fingerprints.title: About the fingerprint library
pageHelp.profiles.body: A profile is one browser identity: its own fingerprint, cookies, proxy and settings, kept apart from every other profile. Create one, then start it to open its browser. Sort profiles into folders and views, and use Peek to look at one without leaving the list.
pageHelp.profiles.title: About profiles
pageHelp.proxies.body: A proxy is the address a profile connects through, so sites see the proxy’s location and not this computer’s. Add SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies here, check that they work, and assign them to profiles. You can also buy proxies from ProxyShard.
pageHelp.proxies.title: About proxies
pageHelp.proxyshard.body: ProxyShard is the proxy service ShardBrowser works with. Connect your account with an API key, then see your balance, plan and orders, and buy proxies for your profiles. The key stays on this computer and goes only to ProxyShard.
pageHelp.proxyshard.title: About ProxyShard
pageHelp.settings.body: Settings control how ShardBrowser looks and behaves on this computer, and what new profiles start with. Each tab groups one kind of setting. Changes apply once you save them.
pageHelp.settings.title: About Settings
pageHelp.trash.body: Deleted profiles stay here for 7 days. Cookies, logins and site storage are kept; caches are not. Restore a profile to get it back, or delete it for good.
pageHelp.trash.title: About Trash

tour.end.body: You can replay this tour any time from Settings.
tour.end.title: You’re all set.
tour.form.create.body: Nothing exists until you press “Create profile”. You can change everything later with “Edit”.
tour.form.create.title: Create the profile
tour.form.extensions.body: This is optional. Check the extensions this profile should load. The list is your extension library.
tour.form.extensions.title: Add extensions
tour.form.fingerprint.body: A fingerprint makes websites see this profile as a particular computer. Choose its operating system, then pick a fingerprint from the list.
tour.form.fingerprint.title: Pick a fingerprint
tour.form.locale.body: “Auto (from proxy)” makes them follow the proxy’s country, so they match where the profile appears to be. Change them only if you need something else.
tour.form.locale.title: Timezone and language
tour.form.name.body: A profile is a separate browser with its own logins and settings. Name it so you recognize it in your list. You can type here now.
tour.form.name.title: Name your profile
tour.form.organize.body: Both are optional. A folder keeps related profiles together, and tags are labels you can filter by.
tour.form.organize.title: Folder and tags
tour.form.proxy.body: A proxy is the address a profile connects through, so websites see its location, not yours. Pick one, choose “No proxy”, or press “Add a new proxy” to paste one.
tour.form.proxy.title: Choose a proxy
tour.formHint: You can see this again from “Show me around” in the form
tour.full.automation.body: A project is a list of steps that runs in a profile’s browser, such as opening a page and clicking a button. “New project” starts one.
tour.full.automation.title: Automate a profile
tour.full.bookmarks.body: A bookmark you add to a folder shows up in every profile in that folder. You save a page once, not in each browser.
tour.full.bookmarks.title: Bookmarks by folder
tour.full.editor.body: Inside a project you add steps one by one. Press “Save” to keep them, then “Run” to play them in your profiles.
tour.full.editor.title: Build, save, run
tour.full.extensions.body: Add Chrome extensions here once. Then you choose which ones each profile gets.
tour.full.extensions.title: Add extensions
tour.full.fingerprints.body: A fingerprint makes a profile look like a different computer to websites. Pick one from this library when you make a profile, or import your own.
tour.full.fingerprints.title: Ready-made computers
tour.full.help.body: Deleted profiles wait in Trash, so you can bring them back. The (i) beside every page title explains that page, and you can replay this tour from Settings.
tour.full.help.title: Trash and help
tour.full.list.body: Each row is one profile, a separate browser with its own proxy and fingerprint. You can show, move and resize the columns.
tour.full.list.title: Your profiles
tour.full.listTools.body: “Filters” keeps only the profiles you want to see. “Display” chooses which columns the list shows.
tour.full.listTools.title: Narrow the list
tour.full.newProfile.body: “New profile” opens a form where you pick the name, proxy and fingerprint. The profile exists only once you press “Create profile”.
tour.full.newProfile.title: Make a profile
tour.full.panel.body: Click a profile and its details open beside the list. “Edit” changes it, and nothing changes until you press “Save”.
tour.full.panel.title: The details panel (Peek)
tour.full.problems.body: When something needs fixing, such as a proxy that fails its test, a card appears above the profile list with a button that fixes it.
tour.full.problems.title: Problems to fix
tour.full.proxies.body: Press “Add proxies” to bring them in, then test that each one works. The list also shows which profiles use each proxy.
tour.full.proxies.title: Add your proxies
tour.full.proxyshard.body: See your ProxyShard balance, and buy traffic or proxies, without leaving the app. You connect your account with an API key.
tour.full.proxyshard.title: Buy traffic and proxies
tour.full.search.body: Find any profile, page or command. Press Ctrl+K, or Cmd+K on macOS, to open it from anywhere.
tour.full.search.title: Search everything
tour.full.settings.body: A change in Settings applies only after you press “Save”. A bar with “Save” and “Don’t save” appears at the bottom as soon as you change something.
tour.full.settings.title: Save your settings
tour.full.sidebar.body: Every page of ShardBrowser is in this list: profiles, proxies, fingerprints and more. Click one to open it.
tour.full.sidebar.title: The sidebar
tour.full.start.body: “Start” opens the profile’s own browser window. Its logins and cookies stay inside that profile.
tour.full.start.title: Start a profile
tour.full.viewsFolders.body: Save a filtered list as a view to open it again in one click. Folders keep related profiles together.
tour.full.viewsFolders.title: Views and folders
tour.replayHint: You can replay the tour from Settings
tour.tips.automation.editor.body: Inside a project you add steps one by one. Press “Save” to keep them, then “Run” to play them in your profiles.
tour.tips.automation.editor.title: Build, save, run
tour.tips.automation.help.body: The (i) also explains modules: files you write that add steps of their own.
tour.tips.automation.help.title: About automation
tour.tips.automation.project.body: A project is a list of steps that runs in a profile’s browser. “New project” starts one.
tour.tips.automation.project.title: Start a project
tour.tips.bookmarks.add.body: A bookmark you add to a folder shows up in every profile in that folder. You save a site once, not in each browser.
tour.tips.bookmarks.add.title: Add a bookmark
tour.tips.bookmarks.help.body: Pick a folder to see what its profiles get. The (i) explains the rest.
tour.tips.bookmarks.help.title: About bookmarks
tour.tips.extensions.add.body: Paste a Web Store link, or add a file or a folder. You add each extension here once.
tour.tips.extensions.add.title: Add an extension
tour.tips.extensions.help.body: An extension runs only in the profiles you turn it on for. The (i) explains how.
tour.tips.extensions.help.title: Turned on per profile
tour.tips.fingerprints.help.body: Each fingerprint is checked against this computer’s GPU. The (i) explains the library, and that you can import your own.
tour.tips.fingerprints.help.title: Made for this computer
tour.tips.fingerprints.library.body: Each fingerprint makes a profile look like a different computer to websites. You pick one when you make a profile.
tour.tips.fingerprints.library.title: Ready-made computers
tour.tips.proxies.add.body: Press “Add proxies” and paste them in, one per line. Then test them to see which ones work.
tour.tips.proxies.add.title: Add your proxies
tour.tips.proxies.help.body: A proxy is the address a profile connects through, so websites see its location and not yours. The (i) explains more.
tour.tips.proxies.help.title: About proxies
tour.tips.proxyshard.buy.body: See your ProxyShard balance, and buy traffic or proxies here, without leaving the app. Your account connects with an API key.
tour.tips.proxyshard.buy.title: Buy traffic and proxies
tour.tips.proxyshard.help.body: ProxyShard is the proxy service ShardBrowser works with. The (i) explains where your key is kept.
tour.tips.proxyshard.help.title: About ProxyShard
tour.tips.settings.help.body: Each tab groups one kind of setting. The (i) says what you can change here.
tour.tips.settings.help.title: About Settings
tour.tips.settings.save.body: A change in Settings applies only after you press “Save”. A bar with “Save” and “Don’t save” appears at the bottom as soon as you change something.
tour.tips.settings.save.title: Changes need “Save”
tour.tips.trash.help.body: Cookies, logins and site storage are kept, but caches are not. The (i) explains what comes back.
tour.tips.trash.help.title: About Trash
tour.tips.trash.page.body: A deleted profile stays in Trash for 7 days. Restore it to get it back, or delete it for good.
tour.tips.trash.page.title: Deleted profiles wait here
tour.tipsHint: You can see this again from the (i) beside the page title
